itemListElement.name: Avoma Alternatives for US Sales Teams in 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Avoma?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies and Fathom Business are the best lower-cost Avoma alternatives with CRM sync. Gong is the best for enterprise revenue intelligence. Lynkk is the best for call prep, live answers and follow-up tasks. If you mainly use Avoma as a note taker, a cheaper tool usually covers it. If you rely on its forecasting, compare Gong instead.

Avoma's main competitors are Gong, Clari Copilot, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Otter.ai, Read AI and Lynkk. They range from full revenue platforms to focused note takers. The right choice depends on whether you need forecasting and coaching, which Gong covers, or mainly notes and CRM updates, which Fireflies and Fathom handle at a lower price per seat.

mainEntity.name: How much does Avoma cost per user?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoma costs $19 per recorder seat per month on Startup and $29 on Organization, billed yearly. Conversation Intelligence and Revenue Intelligence add-ons cost $29 each per seat billed yearly. On monthly billing, the plans cost $29 and $39 per seat. View-only seats are free, so managers who only review calls do not need a paid recorder seat.

Avoma is better for sales teams that want scheduling, coaching and revenue insight in one tool. Otter is better and cheaper if you mainly need transcripts and summaries. For a 10-person team on annual billing, Otter Pro costs about $1,000 a year, while Avoma Organization costs $3,480 before any add-ons.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free Avoma alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom's free plan records unlimited calls, and Lynkk, Otter, Read AI and Fireflies have free plans with limits. Avoma offers a 14-day free trial of its Organization plan. Free plans suit testing on real calls before you commit. Run the same 3 sales calls through 2 tools and compare the notes your reps actually reuse.

mainEntity.name: Does Avoma have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Avoma offers a 14-day free trial of the Organization plan with no credit card required.
